scripts.script:
-- ============================================
-- 🎯 Aimbot — يهدف على راس أقرب لاعب
-- ضعه في Delta / StarterPlayerScripts
-- ============================================

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera      = workspace.CurrentCamera
local PlayerGui   = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- حذف القديم
local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AimbotGui")
if old then old:Destroy() end

-- ================= الحالة =================
local State = {
    Enabled = false,
    Conn    = nil,
    Target  = nil,
}

-- ================= أدوات =================
local function new(class, props, parent)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    if props then
        for k, v in pairs(props) do
            pcall(function() inst[k] = v end)
        end
    end
    if parent then inst.Parent = parent end
    return inst
end

local function corner(p, r)
    return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 8) }, p)
end

-- ================= الحصول على راس اللاعب =================
local function getHead(player)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

-- ================= أقرب لاعب =================
local function getClosestPlayer()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return nil end
    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return nil end

    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local hum  = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if head and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (head.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < closestDist then
                    closestDist = dist
                    closest = p
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

-- ================= تشغيل Aimbot =================
local function startAimbot()
    State.Enabled = true

    State.Conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not State.Enabled then return end

        local target = getClosestPlayer()
        State.Target = target

        if target then
            local head = getHead(target)
            if head then
                -- قفل الكاميرا على الراس
                pcall(function()
                    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, head.Position)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ================= إيقاف Aimbot =================
local function stopAimbot()
    State.Enabled = false
    State.Target = nil
    if State.Conn then
        State.Conn:Disconnect()
        State.Conn = nil
    end
end

-- ================= الواجهة =================
local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "AimbotGui",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, PlayerGui)

local btn = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 55),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -27),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 240),
    Text = "🎯 AIMBOT: OFF",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 15,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    AutoButtonColor = false,
}, gui)
corner(btn, UDim.new(0, 12))

local info = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 20),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, 32),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "اضغط للتشغيل",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
    TextSize = 12,
}, gui)

-- Hover
btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    if not State.Enabled then
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 170, 255)
    end
end)
btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    if not State.Enabled then
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 240)
    end
end)

-- الضغط
btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if State.Enabled then
        stopAimbot()
        btn.Text = "🎯 AIMBOT: OFF"
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 240)
        info.Text = "متوقف"
        info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
    else
        startAimbot()
        btn.Text = "🎯 AIMBOT: ON"
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 210, 130)
        info.Text = "شغال — يهدف على الراس"
        info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 210, 130)
    end
end)

-- تحديث الهدف
task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent do
        task.wait(0.3)
        if State.Enabled and State.Target then
            info.Text = "🎯 " .. State.Target.Name
            info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 210, 130)
        end
    end
end)

print("[Aimbot] تم التحميل")

scripts.script:
Roblox translator v2 (fixed)

--// SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-------------------------------------------------
-- REMOVE OLD GUI
-------------------------------------------------

pcall(function()
    local old = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("UniversalTranslatorGUI")
    if old then
        old:Destroy()
    end
end)

-------------------------------------------------
-- GUI
-------------------------------------------------

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "UniversalTranslatorGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

pcall(function()
    screenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end)

if not screenGui.Parent then
    screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-------------------------------------------------
-- VARIABLES
-------------------------------------------------

local selectedLanguage = "ja"
local minimized = false

-------------------------------------------------
-- MAIN FRAME
-------------------------------------------------

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 540, 0, 320)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -270, 0.5, -160)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)
mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

-------------------------------------------------
-- TOP BAR
-------------------------------------------------

local topBar = Instance.new("Frame")
topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,45)
topBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
topBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
topBar.Parent = mainFrame

local topCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
topCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)
topCorner.Parent = topBar

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(0.7,0,1,0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0.03,0,0,0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Universal Translator"
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextScaled = true
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.Parent = topBar

-------------------------------------------------
-- MINIMIZE BUTTON
-------------------------------------------------

local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0,35,0,35)
minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-45,0.5,-17)
minimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,170,0)
minimizeButton.Text = "-"
minimizeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minimizeButton.TextScaled = true
minimizeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
minimizeButton.Parent = topBar

local minCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
minCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)
minCorner.Parent = minimizeButton

-------------------------------------------------
-- CONTENT FRAME
-------------------------------------------------

local contentFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
contentFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,-45)
contentFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,45)
contentFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
contentFrame.Parent = mainFrame

-------------------------------------------------
-- DRAGGING (FULLY WORKS MINIMIZED)
-------------------------------------------------

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

local function beginDrag(input)

    dragging = true
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPos = mainFrame.Position

    input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

-- DRAG TOP BAR
topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        beginDrag(input)
    end
end)

-- DRAG WHOLE GUI WHEN OPEN
mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    if not minimized then

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            beginDrag(input)
        end
    end
end)

-- UPDATE POSITION
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

    if dragging then

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            local delta = input.Position - dragStart

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end
end)

-------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT BOX
-------------------------------------------------

local inputBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
inputBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.88,0,0,45)
inputBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.06,0,0,15)
inputBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
inputBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter English text..."
inputBox.Text = ""
inputBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
inputBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
inputBox.TextScaled = true
inputBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
inputBox.Parent = contentFrame

Instance.new("UICorner", inputBox)

-------------------------------------------------
-- OUTPUT LABEL
-------------------------------------------------

local outputLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
outputLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.88,0,0,70)
outputLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.06,0,0,75)
outputLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
outputLabel.Text = ""
outputLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
outputLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
outputLabel.TextScaled = true
outputLabel.TextWrapped = true
outputLabel.Parent = contentFrame

Instance.new("UICorner", outputLabel)

-------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTON CONTAINER
-------------------------------------------------

local buttonContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
buttonContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0.88,0,0,120)
buttonContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.06,0,0,165)
buttonContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
buttonContainer.ClipsDescendants = true
buttonContainer.Parent = contentFrame

-------------------------------------------------
-- GRID LAYOUT
-------------------------------------------------

local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0,120,0,40)
grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0,15,0,15)
grid.FillDirectionMaxCells = 3
grid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
grid.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
grid.Parent = buttonContainer

-------------------------------------------------
-- LANGUAGE BUTTONS
-------------------------------------------------

local languages = {
    {"Japanese","ja"},
    {"Korean","ko"},
    {"Chinese","zh-CN"},
}

for _, info in ipairs(languages) do

    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
    button.Text = info[1]
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.Parent = buttonContainer

    Instance.new("UICorner", button)

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        selectedLanguage = info[2]
    end)
end

-------------------------------------------------
-- TRANSLATE BUTTON
-------------------------------------------------

local translateButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
translateButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255)
translateButton.Text = "Translate"
translateButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
translateButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
translateButton.TextScaled = true
translateButton.Parent = buttonContainer

Instance.new("UICorner", translateButton)

-------------------------------------------------
-- TRANSLATION FUNCTION
-------------------------------------------------

local function translateText(text, targetLang)

    local url =
        "https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single" ..
        "?client=gtx" ..
        "&sl=en" ..
        "&tl=" .. targetLang ..
        "&dt=t&q=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(text)

    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)

    if not success then
        return "HTTP Failed"
    end

    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(result)
    end)

    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Decode Failed"
    end

    if data and data[1] and data[1][1] and data[1][1][1] then
        return data[1][1][1]
    end

    return "Translation Error"
end

-------------------------------------------------
-- TRANSLATE
-------------------------------------------------

local function doTranslate()

    local text = inputBox.Text

    if text == "" then
        return
    end

    outputLabel.Text = "Translating..."

    local translated = translateText(text, selectedLanguage)

    outputLabel.Text = translated

    pcall(function()

        if setclipboard then
            setclipboard(translated)
            outputLabel.Text = translated .. " (Copied)"

        elseif toclipboard then
            toclipboard(translated)
            outputLabel.Text = translated .. " (Copied)"
        end
    end)
end

translateButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doTranslate)

-------------------------------------------------
-- ENTER KEY SUPPORT
-------------------------------------------------

inputBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)

    if enterPressed then
        doTranslate()
    end
end)

-------------------------------------------------
-- MINIMIZE SYSTEM
-------------------------------------------------

local normalSize = UDim2.new(0, 540, 0, 320)
local minimizedSize = UDim2.new(0, 540, 0, 45)

minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    minimized = not minimized

    if minimized then

        contentFrame.Visible = false
        mainFrame.Size = minimizedSize
        minimizeButton.Text = "+"

    else

        contentFrame.Visible = true
        mainFrame.Size = normalSize
        minimizeButton.Text = "-"
    end
end)
